description: Capability-oriented evidence collection tasks. Answer values live in evaluator-only oracles, not this catalog.

tasks.title: Visible access table
tasks.prompt: Collect the current user access list from Northstar Access. Return a CSV containing User, Email, Role, and Status in the displayed order, plus a full-page screenshot.

tasks.title: Facts from a policy page
tasks.prompt: Open the Information Security Policy and report its owner, version, effective date, and next review date. Include a screenshot showing those fields.

tasks.title: Direct document download
tasks.prompt: Download the latest finalized quarterly access-review report. Return the original file and report its title, publication date, MIME type, and byte size.

tasks.title: Filtering and pagination
tasks.prompt: In the user directory, select Status = Active and Access Level = Privileged. Collect every matching result across all pages into a CSV and capture the filtered page.

tasks.title: Data hidden in detail drawers
tasks.prompt: Create a vendor-review CSV with Vendor, Risk Level, Owner, Last Review Date, and Reviewer Email. Reviewer Email is available from each vendor's details panel. Sort high-risk vendors first, then by oldest review date.

tasks.title: Tabs, iframe, and report download
tasks.prompt: Open the Compliance section, select the Change Management tab, and inspect the embedded quarterly report. Return its record count, a screenshot of the report, and the downloadable PDF.

tasks.title: Virtualized security-event table
tasks.prompt: Collect all failed privileged-login events from the last seven days. Return Event ID, User, Timestamp, Source IP, and Failure Reason as a CSV, deduplicated by Event ID and sorted newest first.

tasks.title: Cross-system orphan-account reconciliation
tasks.prompt: Compare the HR employee roster with the identity-management directory. Identify active accounts belonging to terminated employees. Return a CSV with Employee ID, Name, Termination Date, Account ID, Role, and Last Login, plus a summary count and screenshots from both systems.

tasks.title: Visually encoded approval state
tasks.prompt: Find invoices over $25,000 from the current quarter that do not have final approval. Return Invoice ID, Vendor, Amount, Approver, and Approval State, with screenshots proving each exception.

tasks.title: Multi-site liveness assessment
tasks.prompt: From the Evidence Systems index, check every linked portal and determine whether each is operational. Return a CSV containing Portal, Observed Status, Observation Time, Final URL, and Evidence Reference, followed by a short summary of any unavailable systems.

tasks.title: Long offboarding evidence workflow
tasks.prompt: Prepare an offboarding evidence package for employee E-1042. Collect the HR termination record, active application access, repository memberships, and outstanding company assets. Return a summary, reconciliation CSV, screenshots, and the downloaded termination notice. Do not disable, revoke, remove, or edit anything.

tasks.title: Partial completion after session expiry
tasks.prompt: Reconcile privileged access across HR, identity management, and source control. If any system cannot be accessed, preserve the evidence already collected and clearly identify what remains unverified.
